title: Clarify Database Schema
problem_statement: The source and target database schemas are not specified, which is critical for accurate data conversion.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential data loss or corruption during migration.
suggested_approach: Engage with stakeholders to gather detailed database schema information.
success_criteria: Complete database schema details are documented.
Data migration scripts are validated against the schema.

provenance.evidence: Absence of database details in the analysis.
